blocks.text:
Today you leave Rio and fly to Foz do Iguaçu. On arrival, the change in surroundings is immediately apparent: the air is more humid, dense tropical vegetation appears, and the urban landscape gives way to the national park.

The Iguazu Falls formed at a break in the basalt plateau on the border between Brazil and Argentina. The river reaches the edge and drops in more than 270 separate cascades extending for almost 3 km.

The experience begins even before your first full excursion. You hear the roar from a distance; the air is heavy with moisture and spray hangs over the canyon. After the noise of New Year celebrations in Rio, the setting could hardly be more different: the music and crowds give way to the uninterrupted sound of water.

The Iguazu River approaches the basalt escarpment as a wide, calm stream, then breaks into hundreds of cascades. Every bend in the trail reveals a different view: a long chain of white water through the forest, a single torrent filling the view, or a powerful section where you need to raise your voice to be heard. High water in early January amplifies the effect.

blocks.text: 3 January: Brazilian Side of Iguazu Falls

provenance.wordAbsenceReason: The Word 2027 schedules the Brazilian falls visit for 4 January, whereas this Russian title is explicitly dated 3 January; the dates cannot be treated as identical.

blocks.text:
After breakfast, head to the Brazilian side of the falls. The trail follows the canyon: at first you hear the rumble; then individual cascades appear between the trees and the full system gradually comes into view.

The name “Iguazu” comes from Guarani and means “Big Water”. The Brazilian side is particularly well suited to panoramic views. Instead of a single wall of water, you can see a long line of streams plunging into the gorge.

December and January are high-water months. The flows become stronger, clouds of spray rise higher and the sound is almost physical. The final section of the trail leads towards the Devil’s Throat, where water falls into a narrow canyon amid dense mist. On sunny days, rainbows appear over the cascades.
